title: Animal card set for sorting
subject: Science
unit: Spring 1: Living things and their habitats (Frozen Kingdom)
source: Seeded from science/y6 lesson 11 (Animal card set for sorting (portal worksheet))
intro: Lesson 11: Vertebrates and invertebrates. To understand how the animal kingdom is divided into vertebrates and invertebrate groups

questions.q: Is a krill a vertebrate or an invertebrate? Which group?
questions.model: Does it have a backbone? No, it has a hard outer shell. So it is an invertebrate. Hard shell and many legs: crustacean.

questions.q: How many legs does an insect have?
Core: Sort 12 animals (portal card set) into vertebrate groups and invertebrate groups.
questions.a: Answers in the card set key.
questions.model: Teacher sorts two first: seal (fur, milk: mammal), beetle (6 legs: insect).

questions.q: Extend: Is a woodlouse an insect? Explain using features.
questions.a: No: it has 14 legs; it is a crustacean.

questions.q: Stretch: Draw a Venn diagram for 'lives in water' and 'has a backbone' with 8 animals.
questions.a: Accept a correct Venn, e.g. both: seal, fish; water only: jellyfish, krill.

questions.q: Six legs and three body parts means an...
Big question: what has a skeleton on the outside?
questions.a: Invertebrates such as insects and crabs: an exoskeleton.
